The design text the pins hold (`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §3.6 *The placement rule*): "The search runs outward from the

charge per candidate tried are that sentence's plain reading; the code and `insert/placement.ts` agree (PLAUSIBLE for
the reading, CONFIRMED for the behaviour).
